bio: I build web apps end to end and look after what's left of a project once the hype fades.
status: Building products for the web · Brazil, UTC−3

about.label: About
about.p1: That's 9 years of web development. I started on the front end, picked up the back because the projects needed it, and today I introduce myself by what I actually do: full-stack in TypeScript, from the database to the interface.
about.p2: React and Next.js on the front, NestJS and PostgreSQL on the back. I like code that keeps explaining itself after I leave the project, and products that solve the user's problem, not my urge to try the new tool.
about.p3: Right now I'm <accent>studying AI engineering</accent>: LLM apps, RAG, agents and evals. Nothing shipped to the portfolio yet, so I treat it as what it is, study, not a service.

contact.label: Contact
contact.title: Got a project, or just want to talk code?
contact.description: I take freelance, consulting and mentoring. Pure AI projects not yet, I'm studying and I don't charge for what I can't deliver. I reply within two business days.
